Task 5: found a genuine bug-class issue - AddMicroseconds/AddMilliseconds/AddSeconds/AddMinutes/AddHours/AddDays/Add(TimeSpan) all multiply their arg by a constant in an UNCHECKED context before calling AddNanoseconds, so for very large inputs (e.g. AddHours(long.MaxValue)) the multiplication silently overflows/wraps BEFORE AddNanoseconds' own overflow check can catch it, producing a silently wrong DateTimeNano instead of throwing. Fixed by wrapping each multiplication in checked(...). Added 6 new overflow tests (one per method). 96/96 tests passing on net8/9/10. Created draft PR via safeoutputs. Updated Monthly Activity issue #38.
